##### Project general facts

Asayel is a premium residential development within Madinat Jumeirah Living, offering a selection of 1-, 2-, 3-, and 4-bedroom apartments in a vibrant and exclusive community. Featuring classic architectural design and contemporary interiors, the residences are thoughtfully designed to provide comfort, privacy, and impressive views of the surrounding area. The development combines elegant design with high standards of quality, creating a refined environment for both living and investment.

Residents can enjoy a range of state-of-the-art amenities and facilities designed to enhance everyday living. The community provides a secure and comfortable environment where residents can benefit from well-planned shared spaces and convenient facilities. Its carefully designed setting creates a balanced lifestyle with a strong focus on quality, comfort, and security.

The residences feature contemporary interiors with progressive design elements, high-end fittings, and carefully considered details that give each home its own distinctive character. Built to high international standards, the apartments offer a comfortable and refined living environment with an equipped kitchen and quality finishes throughout. The residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Asayel Apartments connected by well-established road network - Jumeirah Beach Road and Umm Squeem Road - and linked by a footbridge to Madinat Jumeira, this privileged development enjoys great food and beverage on its doorstep, close proximity to schools, retail offering, entertainment, and luxury hospitality. 

A central pedestrian walkway meanders through Madinat Jumeirah Living, providing access to private community entrances. Communal roof terraces with BBQ areas also offer magnificent views of Madinat Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab and the sea.

Located 20 minutes from Dubai International Airport, and nestled in Madinat Jumeirah, Madinat Jumeirah Living is also just a few minutes from Dubai Media City, Dubai Internet City, Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina. It is adjacent to Burj Al Arab, Wild Wadi Waterpark, Jumeirah Beach Hotel, major shopping malls, public transport links and schools.
